events.title: rock is part of Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Happy to announce rock\ is part of the Steam Next Fest!Over the last 4 months, the rock\ demo has been tweaked, refined, and perfected! It's now a condensed hour-long game which rivals most released incremental games!Please go and check out it out, new or returning, and I'll guarantee you'll discover something new!And, please leave a review on the demo page, so more people can see it. As a solo dev, this 2 minute activity helps massively in getting more exposure + giving me valuable feedback abo

events.title: v0.6.1 - less clicking, more fun
events.summary: so...much...balancing... since I started dev on rock\, I've struggled with the "spam-clicking" aspect. On one hand, I want to give players full agency of the game, including the scientist's hitbar. If that means they want to spam-click and upgrade the red portion, they are free to do so. events.title: rock 's free demo is available now!
events.summary: I hate to be the one to tell you all this, but after a pummeling, your rock\ has had no choice but to land on Dyrt...But, never fear, for Dyrt's residents are very capable, and have offered to help you escape!Each playthrough is a little different!The free demo is available now and offers:⏰: 45-60 minutes of gameplay🌏: 1 planet⚙️: 6 different upgrade systems💎: 6 different minerals♾️: endless mode🤖: NO AIDon't forget to leave a review and happy exploring! :)
